# Planning Telemetry

In an ADR, record the telemetry strategy under **Consequences**. In a PRD, capture testable telemetry criteria under **Success Metrics** and **Operational Readiness**. Cite the approved vocabulary or specification supporting each instrument; when available, use `telemetry-foundations` for trace, metric, log, PII, and resource-attribute guidance. Describe the signal and record any naming or privacy question for review rather than inventing a convention or including sensitive values.
